overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the non-repeated (unique) values of a field for the current selection, sorted ascending via the field's index, and optionally the occurrence count of each value.

overloadMerges.note: array and countArray are filled/returned arrays (docs: 'Array to receive field data' / 'Array to receive count of each value'); autoparse defaults all params to direction:in.

params.name: aField
params.description: Indexable field to use for data; unindexed fields are supported but slower

params.name: array
params.description: Receives the distinct field values, sorted ascending using the field's index; must match aField's type (retyped if necessary, except Picture fields with a keyword index, which require a Text array)

params.name: countArray
params.description: Receives, for each value in array, its number of occurrences in the current selection; not supported (returned empty) for text/picture fields with a keyword index

constraints: Does not support Object type fields.
For Text fields, a keyword index (if any) is always used in preference to a standard index; for Picture fields, a keyword index is required or the array is returned empty.
Executing on an unindexed field is slower and loses the current record.
On 4D Server, the array is built and values calculated server-side, then the whole array is sent to the client.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.
